_doc: Product files that are in no module YET, each with the arch025 lane that registers it (D11). cpu_census prints
them as WARN and fails on any other unregistered product file; an entry that matches no unregistered file is
stale and fails, so this list only shrinks; release mode (census_check.py --release) fails while any entry is
left. The main session removes an entry when it merges the lane that registered those files.
